reconcile.note: Jamieson, Fausset & Brown read Paul's all Israel as a future national ingathering distinct from the unbelieving remnant Jesus threatens with exclusion in Matthew.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Krister Stendahl catalogues this as a contradiction, but the project's public-domain source survey found no verbatim critic passage that engages it.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Krister Stendahl, Paul Among Jews and Gentiles (1976).
